The Service

What We Clean

Moss, lichen, dirt, grime, and organic staining build up on hard surfaces over time — especially in Sydney's climate. High-pressure washing removes it completely, restoring surfaces to a clean finish without harsh chemicals.

  • Brick Paver Driveways

    The most visible surface on any property. Clean pavers dramatically improve street presence.

  • Concrete Paths & Footpaths

    Council footpaths and internal paths — cleaned and cleared of slippery growth.

  • Courtyards & Entertainment Areas

    Tile, stone, and concrete entertaining spaces restored for outdoor living.

  • Garden Paths & Steps

    Natural stone and concrete garden paths cleaned safely without damaging the surface.

  • Retaining Walls

    Sandstone, brick, and concrete retaining walls — staining and lichen removed.

"Often pairs well with a garden tidy-up or hedge trim — one visit to restore the whole property."
